HeroQuest Card Creator gives you a purpose-built workflow for HeroQuest homebrew.

Use it to make hero cards, monster cards, treasure cards, card backs, printable decks, and reusable collections without rebuilding the same layout system every time.

Make HeroQuest cards with the right structure from the start

Use dedicated HeroQuest-style templates

Create front-facing and back-facing cards with layouts tuned for the classic HeroQuest look, including title handling, artwork placement, icon controls, and template-specific fields.

Organise cards and assets as a working library

Save cards, group them into collections, manage reusable assets, and keep larger homebrew projects coherent instead of treating every card as a one-off image.

Export for digital sharing and physical play

Export PNG card images, prepare paired fronts and backs, and generate deck PDFs with print-oriented options for paper size, margins, crop marks, and cut marks.

Built for HeroQuest fans creating real tabletop material

If you are writing new quests, treasure decks, equipment packs, monster abilities, spell systems, or larger fan expansions, HeroQuest Card Creator is designed to help you make cards that feel at home beside the original game components while still being fast to revise and scale up.

It is not a generic card graphic template. It is a browser-based card tool built around the needs of HeroQuest homebrew work.

Quick answers

Can I use HeroQuest Card Creator online?

The app is distributed through itch.io and runs in your browser. The downloadable version can also be used locally.

Can I use it for custom HeroQuest quests and expansions?

Yes. It is designed for fan-made cards covering heroes, monsters, treasure, equipment, card backs, and larger deck systems.

Where do I learn the workflow?

Start with the Getting Started guides or jump into the FAQ and troubleshooting pages.
